{{Top|leg}}
The '''Living Monorail''' was a mass transit system on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ergeshui/Legends|Ergeshui]] that linked the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Erglush]] to [[Outworlder City]]. It was a living organism, consisting of two huge vines fixed in place by root systems. A bean-shaped growth acted as a car, and slid along the vine propelled by [[Methane/Legends|methane]] gas and [[Photosynthesis/Legends|photosynthetic]] charge. Each car could hold forty [[Ergesh]], or eighty [[Human/Legends|Humans]].
